description: VISA Base I-style scheme simulator — stands in for VisaNet for loopback testing. Handles authorization (0100/0200), reversal & advice (0400/0420), network management (0800) and clearing advice (0220/0520) over ISO 8583. Functional fidelity from public ISO 8583; NOT a byte-exact copy of VISA's confidential field specs. Stand-in (STIP) approves auths unless a limit/BIN/expiry rule declines.
